page_title: LAZ 3-2 GEN | Lazio v Genoa 30/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+10' 3 - 2 Goal! Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Justin Bijlow.
90+9' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) is going to take the penalty!
90+7' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
90+7' Referee Luca Zufferli makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
90+7' Surely that's handball by one of the Genoa players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90+5' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit.

90+4' What a wasted opportunity by Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom right corner, but Justin Bijlow makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
90+3' That's a clear yellow card. Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) goes into the book.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
87' Substitution. Gustav Isaksen makes his way off the pitch and Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) comes on as his replacement.
87' Daniele De Rossi has decided to make a change. Patrizio Masini (Genoa) replaces Ruslan Malinovskyi.
87' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
85' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
82' The game has come to an end for Kenneth Taylor. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luca Pellegrini leaves the pitch and Nuno Tavares (Lazio) comes on.
80' Daniele De Rossi prepares a substitution. Vitinha is replaced by Maxwel Cornet (Genoa).
80' Substitution. Lorenzo Colombo leaves the pitch and is replaced by Caleb Ekuban (Genoa).
79' Genoa are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
75' 2 - 2 Goal! Vitinha (Genoa) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 2:2.
75' Genoa force a corner. They send men into the box.
74' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) picks up a yellow card.
73' Pedro will be replaced by Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio).
72' Maurizio Sarri has decided to substitute Daniel Maldini and he is replaced by Petar Ratkov (Lazio).
72' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
72' Toma Basic (Lazio) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
68' Substitution. Junior Messias (Genoa) in, Aaron Martin out.
67' Ivan Provedel (Lazio) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Luca Zufferli lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
67' 2 - 1 Goal! Ivan Provedel gets a hand on the penalty from Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa), but can't stop it from flying inside the left post.
67' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
66' Referee Luca Zufferli awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
65' Referee Luca Zufferli makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Genoa. Let’s see what happens!
65' Surely that's handball by one of the Lazio players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
64' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) is booked for saying more than Luca Zufferli was willing to tolerate.
64' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

62' 2 - 0 A superb goal from great team play! Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
61' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Justin Bijlow.
56' 1 - 0 Goal! Pedro (Lazio) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Justin Bijlow to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
56' Pedro (Lazio) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
56' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
53' There's a break in play and referee Luca Zufferli must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Lazio using VAR. This could be interesting!
53' Surely that's handball by one of the Genoa players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
51' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
50' The corner is swung in but Lazio can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
49' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Justin Bijlow makes a smart save to deny him.

48' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lazio are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Toma Basic (Lazio) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
44' A quickly taken corner by Lazio.
43' Daniel Maldini (Lazio) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Justin Bijlow.
42' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle after Leo Ostigard (Genoa) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
40' Adam Marusic (Lazio) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His glancing header goes over the crossbar.
39' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lazio comes to nothing.
34' Genoa keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
31' Lazio failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
27' A pass by Leo Ostigard (Genoa) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
26' A cross from a corner kick by Genoa is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
26' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Vitinha (Genoa) inside the box.
23' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) jumps into a tackle and Luca Zufferli signals a foul.
20' Aaron Martin (Genoa) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
19' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
18' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Leo Ostigard (Genoa) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
15' Toma Basic (Lazio) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Gustav Isaksen, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
15' Lazio seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

12' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Ivan Provedel thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
10' The resulting set piece from Lazio is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

10' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
10' The linesman's flag goes up. Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) is caught in the offside trap.
9' The Genoa players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
7' A rebound sits up perfectly for Toma Basic (Lazio), who connects nicely with the ball from mid-range but sends it miles wide of the right post.
4' Wonderful movement by Genoa. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Genoa will have the kick-off.
Luca Zufferli will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
